about: The reviewer configuration the product ships, as one file.
Every knob below is read by the engine (packages/intelligence/src/review/llm/llm-review-engine.ts) and by the
benchmark harness (.github/scripts/aacr-bench.mjs), so an arm and the shipped default cannot be two numbers that
never meet. The engine reads a generated module (review-defaults.generated.ts) rendered from this file; a guard
test renders it again and fails when the two disagree.
This file is written by a promotion and by nothing else. `node .github/scripts/aacr-promote.mjs --write <arms...>`
decides whether a challenger beat the incumbent under the pre-registered rule in promotion-rule.json, and rewrites
this file only when it did. Editing it by hand is possible and the promotion record in `provenance` is then wrong,
which is what the guard test is for.

incumbent.summary: the replay of the 452-golden corpus, whose F1 curve peaks at a budget of 12

challengers.cause: unwired: maxFindingsPerPullRequest is read inside reviewPullRequest and nowhere else, so the 20 never reached the file arm and the headline is what the engine emits with nothing cut at all

whyHeld: R-67 is the only challenger and it is not a measurement of the knob it names, so the incumbent stands untested
rather than defended. A challenger that did not apply its own knob is refused by the `not-applied` reason in
aacr-promote.mjs, which is the reason that exists for this exact record.
